from transformers import AutoTokenizer

with open('data/wikievents/ontology_constraints_wikievents.json') as f:
    ontology = json.load(f)
entity_types = ontology['entity_types']

tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('/root/autodl-tmp/models/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-ms/mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0___3/')

prefix_to_types = defaultdict(set)
for token_id in tok.get_vocab().values():
    try:
        decoded = tok.decode([token_id])

        continue
    if decoded in prefix_types:
        prefix_to_types[token_id].update(prefix_types[decoded])
prefix_map = dict(prefix_to_types)

long_ctx = '\"type\": \"'

for et in entity_types:

    full_str = long_ctx + et + '\"'

    et_ids = full_ids[len(long_ctx_ids):]
    if et_ids and et_ids[-1] == q_tok:
        et_ids = et_ids[:-1]
    gen_first = et_ids[0] if et_ids else None

    in_map = gen_first in prefix_map if gen_first is not None else False
    gen_tok_str = repr(tok.decode([gen_first])) if gen_first is not None else 'N/A'
    bare_tok_str = repr(tok.decode([bare_ids[0]]))
    match_bare = '=bare' if gen_first == bare_ids[0] else '!=bare'
    status = 'OK' if in_map else 'MISSING'
    if not in_map and gen_first is not None:
        gen_missing.append((et, gen_first, gen_tok_str))
    print(f'{et:<8} {str(gen_first):<8} {gen_tok_str:<16} {bare_ids[0]:<8} {bare_tok_str:<16} {match_bare:<10} {status}')

print()
if gen_missing:
    print(f'MISSING: {gen_missing}')
else:
    print('All generation-context tokens found in prefix map.')

# In-context collision groups
print()
print('In-context collision groups:')
groups = defaultdict(list)
for et in entity_types:
    full_str = long_ctx + et + '\"'
    full_ids = tok.encode(full_str, add_special_tokens=False)
    et_ids = full_ids[len(long_ctx_ids):]
    if et_ids and et_ids[-1] == q_tok:
        et_ids = et_ids[:-1]
    gen_first = et_ids[0] if et_ids else None
    groups[gen_first].append(et)

for tid, ets in sorted(groups.items(), key=lambda x: -len(x[1])):

        print(f'  token={tid} {repr(tok.decode([tid]))}: {ets}')
" 2>&1
